item.title: Dalen Terry, Thunder Agree To Two-Year Contract
item.description:
The Oklahoma City Thunder and veteran wing Dalen Terry have agreed to a two-year contract. Terry will fill the Thunder's open roster spot and will give the team some much needed depth.

Last season, Terry split the campaign between the Chicago Bulls and Philadelphia 76ers. Terry was traded by the Bulls to the New York Knicks at the trade deadline, then he signed a two-way contract with the Sixers. From there, the 6-foot-7 wing signed a standard contract with Philadelphia.

The Thunder are currently down six players due to injuries. That includes Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, who are expected to miss the remainder of the season, and Chet Holmgren who is out for 8-10 weeks.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama, Jayson Tatum Named NBA's Players Of Week 2
item.description:
Victor Webmanyama and Jayson Tatum have been named the NBA's Players of Week 2.

Wembanyama averaged 36.0 points, 10.3 rebounds and 4.3 blocks as the San Antonio Spurs went 3-0.

Tatum averaged 30.3 points, 5.8 rebounds and 7.0 assists as the Boston Celtics went 4-0 on the week.
